description: This file defines a custom Android UI component, TouchHighlightImageButton, which extends ImageButton to add a visual highlight effect when pressed or focused, using a drawable overlay.

classes.name: TouchHighlightImageButton
classes.description: A custom ImageButton that overlays a highlight drawable to indicate pressed and focused states.

methods.name: TouchHighlightImageButton
methods.description: Constructors initializing the custom button with context, attributes, and style.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view by resetting background and padding, and retrieving the highlight drawable from theme attributes.

methods.name: drawableStateChanged
methods.description: Updates the highlight drawable's state to match the button's state and triggers a redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the button image and overlays the highlight drawable.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Caches the view bounds when size changes.
